output.reason: PMK 168/2023 replaces PMK 252/PMK.03/2008 and PMK 250/PMK.03/2008. It introduces a new PPh 21 calculation method for permanent employees (Pegawai Tetap). For every tax period other than the last one, withholding is the monthly effective rate (TER) multiplied by monthly gross income. In the last tax period, it is the annual tax under the Article 17 rates minus the tax already withheld. The regulation also defines the gross income components, including employer-paid JKK, JKM and health contributions and insurance premiums. It sets the allowable deductions: biaya jabatan at 5%, capped at Rp500.000 per month or Rp6.000.000 per year, plus pension/JHT contributions and zakat. It further covers PTKP rules, rounding of taxable income down to the full thousand rupiah, proration for partial-year tax subjects, and refund of over-withholding. It is effective from 1 January 2024.
